verdict.rationale: LlamaParse documents async job status via webhooks (avoiding polling) and offers self-hosted/BYOC deployment for scaling infrastructure, which supports high-volume async workflows, but there is no documented rate-limit table, batch-submission API, or throughput/SLA numbers for millions-of-pages workloads. Missing for 10: explicit rate-limit documentation, batch endpoint semantics, throughput benchmarks or SLAs for large-scale ingestion.
